scope: Six independently audited paired cycles, not completion of twenty distinct models
return_definition: 100 * (ending capital / initial capital - 1); cumulative, after modeled trading costs
audit: Slurm CPU step in job2124996 using each run's immutable candidate4 source; recomputed accounting must equal original saved receipt; no original experiment file changed
ledger_content: Every dated decision, holdings before decision, accepted target or explicit failure/hold, tool execution/delivery observations, all daily NAV entries and trade/cost ledger, original record hashes
excluded_content: Raw news, full prompts and provider transcripts stay in original Beacon archives; this is the full public decision/accounting ledger, not a full transcript export
negative_and_failed_results: Preserved. Granite seed37 raw has one unresolved negative-CASH decision and keeps existing units under declared failure handling; it is not counted as an intentional hold
seven_b: All three paired cycles had zero actual research/library calls; return differences do not demonstrate a tool-execution benefit
research_error_parse: Counts failed responses during the research phase, including malformed early submit; it is not a count of failed research-tool calls
limits: Retrospective development data, not unseen holdout
Historical source vintages assumed, not independently verified
Three seeds are not three independent market regimes
No causal return attribution to an interface fix
Per-run batch, generated-token budget and final output contract are explicitly exported
